resources.string: Exit through WARP: device → selected VPN → WARP → internet. Applies to routes through the current VPN. Direct routes, LAN, excluded apps and rules explicitly selecting another profile retain their routing. WireGuard/AmneziaWG require UDP support on the main VPN. If WARP fails, traffic assigned to it has no automatic fallback. Export a copy to Profiles to use WARP on its own.
Remove this configuration locally, or revoke the registered device at Cloudflare and remove it. Exported profile copies are independent; revoking the device also invalidates them.
Disable WARP exit before deleting its selected configuration.

Generating a configuration registers a device with Cloudflare and accepts the WARP terms: https://www.cloudflare.com/application/terms/\n\nRegistration uses the active VPN when connected. Without an active VPN, registration connects directly. Keys and the registration token are saved in app settings and included in app backups.
